metadata.timestampNote: Seconds on Unity realtime clock. RTMPose time is camera availability; baseline is callback delivery. guide_cue recordedAt is speech enqueue, not audible onset. Video is not encoded. REC time/frame aligns optional screen video.
metadata.imageCoordinates: Native model order. x is scaled by upright image aspect, y is up. Joint arrays are not reordered for avatar mirroring; arm features are. Halpe26 ROI uses normalized x-right/y-down.

caveat: New recording; prior video exclusion does not apply. Accepted observations only; calibration samples before acceptance absent.
